en.name: Dretch
en.ability: Each night*, a player dies. After being nominated, you may call for help: if fewer alive players are evil than good, a Minion becomes a Dretch.

revisions.v1: Each night*, a player dies. After being nominated, you may call for help: if fewer alive players are evil than good, a Minion becomes a Dretch.

en.otherNightReminder: Choose a player: they die (the Storyteller decides).

zh.name: 劣魔
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，会有一名玩家死亡。你可以在被提名后呼唤同伴：如果存活玩家中邪恶玩家更少，一名爪牙会变成劣魔。
